title: Layer 2 round 2 minor SE+security+DE triple-convergent: stderr truncates before the absolute-root sanitize — a cut mid-path leaks a partial user-absolute path into a record-destined diagnostic; sanitize also misses the canonical and home forms

comments.author: xqjG
comments.content: Fixed in a49206fe (producer half) and 74b01866-adjacent refs.rs changes: run_bounded returns Refused stderr WHOLE up to the 4KiB capture bound; the diagnostic site sanitizes first and truncates to 500 chars after, so a cut can no longer bisect a path out of the exact-match replace. Sanitize now folds the given AND canonicalized root spellings to '.' (the darwin /private alias) and renders a non-empty HOME prefix as '~', root replacements ordered before the home one.
